title: Aliens
build: US Activision disk, 'Aliens [Activision].d64', a cracked copy: a Remember cracktro and trainer (22 KB BASIC file at $0801) in front of ten packed game files A0-A9

records.c: The title's entry points: start ($8000) and restart ($8002), both $8028; the 18 object table addresses after them are $8028 too, as the title uses no engine objects.

The entry byte both vectors name, and a flag. title_clear sets it to 0 and title_raster sets bit 7 again once tune2 has passed its fifth marker, after which RETURN is accepted. Run as code, $80 is an undocumented two-byte NOP that swallows the SEI after it; its value as the file arrives was not observed.
Starts the title: the stack reset, a black border, the bitmap off, the raster call to title_raster ($8238), and the VIC-II set from the list after the call.

VIC-II bank 1, sprites off, text at the screen $5C00 and bitmap $6000, the screen and bitmap cleared (title_clear); then the stage set to 0 and the marines byte to $FF (all eight alive), and tune2 started.

Each pass: tune2's marker count $057B picks the logo step (logo_steps) and the credit (credit_steps). RETURN (title_raster sets $0605 bit 7) ends the stage with stage_complete; the end of the cycle ($0609) clears the screen and starts tune2 again.
A new credit: its bitmap rows cleared (credit_clear_bitmap), its colours black (credit_colours with 0), the credit unpacked from credit_unpackers, and its colours orange ($80).
The credit routine's address, low byte (written here).
A new logo step: its two handlers from logo_once and logo_each written into the JSRs at $80F9 and $80FC, and the first run once.
The step's handler for every pass.
The handler each logo step runs once, by step 0 to 7: nothing, logo frame 1, the colour band ($8194), nothing, nothing, frame 4, the band white ($81AF), nothing.
logo_once read from its second byte: each handler's high byte.
The handler each step runs every pass: nothing, logo_rows, flicker between frames 1 and 2, between 2 and 3, between 3 and 4, the colours between blue and white, nothing, and title_end_wait.
logo_each from its second byte: the high bytes.
Logo step 0's handlers: an RTS each.
Step 2's first pass: the logo's band blue (logo_band_blue).
At random, logo frame 1 or frame 2: the random byte $0600 is rotated left and its old top bit picks the frame.
The trainer pokes $8139 when it loads level 6; here it is the BCS's offset.
Inside the JSR: the trainer pokes $813A when it loads level 6, whose own code lies here then.
The trainer pokes $813B too, for level 6.
At random, the logo band blue or white, each pass.
Inside the JSR: the trainer pokes $8178 when it loads level 4, whose own code lies here then.
Step 6's first pass: the band white.
Step 6's every pass and step 7's first: an RTS each.
Step 7: waits 255 frames and then 128 more, holding the finished logo, and asks for the cycle to start again ($0609 = $80).
Fills the logo's band of the screen ($5CF0-$5E07) with $60, blue pixels on black.
Fills the band with A (by fill_memory, Y the byte).
The band with 0, black: the logo hidden.
The logo appearing: every 128 frames one more row of the band shows, from the bottom ($0602 counts 7 down), and each pass the rows shown flicker at random between blue and black.
The raster call: level_frame, a random byte to $0600, sprite 0 (the gleam in the logo's I, frame 0 at x $99, y $78, white) on at random during step 7, RETURN accepted once return_armed is set.
Arms RETURN once $057B reaches 5, so the first pass of the cycle cannot be skipped in its first seconds.
RETURN ($0221 = $0D) asks title_loop to end the stage ($0605 = $80).
The gleam's place and colour; sprite pointer 0 is frame 0.
The credit shown at each of tune2's 30 markers, then six zeros: 0 leaves the screen as it is; 1 to 7 pick from credit_unpackers.
The logo step at each of tune2's 30 markers (0 to 7).
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $83D9 ($83D9), 894 bytes long.
Logo frame 1's packed length, then the RTS.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $8757 ($8757), 989 bytes long.
Logo frame 2's packed length, then the RTS.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $8B34 ($8B34), 812 bytes long.
Logo frame 3's packed length, then the RTS.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $8E60 ($8E60), 298 bytes long.
Logo frame 4's packed length, then the RTS.
Clears the credits' part of the bitmap, $71A0-$7D9F.
Writes A into the credits' ten rows of the screen (34 cells from $5E34), the colours of their pixels.
The routine that draws each credit, by number 0 to 7: nothing, then the seven unpack calls at $8357-$838E.
credit_unpackers from its second byte: the high bytes.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $E000 ($E000), 300 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 1, then the RTS.
"A computer game by Steve Cartwright, Glyn Anderson, Peter Kaminski, Gene Smith" (credit_text_2).
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $E12C ($E12C), 1028 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 2, then the RTS.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $E530 ($E530), 472 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 3, then the RTS.
Inside the JSR: unpack_inline's high byte.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $E708 ($E708), 326 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 4, then the RTS.
"Based on a film by James Cameron".
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $E84E ($E84E), 451 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 5, then the RTS.
"Computer software program, copyright 1986 Activision, Inc., all rights reserved, press RETURN to start": credit 7, though it comes before credit 6 in memory.
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $EA11 ($EA11), 1093 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 7, then the RTS.
"The motion picture "Aliens" TM, copyright 1986 Twentieth Century Fox Film Corp., all rights reserved".
unpack_inline's arguments: the packed data at $EE56 ($EE56), 1115 bytes long.
The packed length of credit 6, then the RTS.
The screen and the colour RAM cleared and return_armed cleared; then, as at each new cycle, title_reset.

Page 6 cleared, sprites off, the marker count $057B to 0, no logo step or credit shown ($FF), the bitmap cleared, all seven logo rows hidden ($0602 = 7, the band black), and the rest of the screen ($5E30-$5FE7) orange on black ($80).
Inside the JSR: the trainer pokes $839C when it loads level 1, whose own code lies here then.
The trainer pokes $839D too, for level 1.
Starts tune2 (start_music), the tune the whole title follows.
Logo frame 1, packed (894 bytes): the ALIENS logo forming, its letters broken up.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $8798 when it loads level 5.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $881B for level 3.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $8854 for level 3.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $88A9 for level 6.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $88AC for level 6.
More of frame 2; the trainer pokes $88B5 for level 6.
The end of frame 2; the trainer pokes $8A89 for level 2.
More of frame 3; the trainer pokes $8B64 for level 5.
Logo frame 4, packed (298 bytes, to $8F89): the finished logo.
More of frame 4; the trainer pokes $8E8E for level 4.
More of frame 4; the trainer pokes $8EB8 for level 4.
The end of frame 4; the trainer pokes $8F66 for level 2.
Zero bytes to the end of the page.
The last four bytes of credit 2.
